description: NaLiCl₂ is Caswellsilverite-like structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. Li is bonded to six Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, edges with four equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra, and edges with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to four equivalent Na and two equivalent Li atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Li atoms to form ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ClNa₂Li₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ClNa₄Li₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
